package repository

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

// KnowledgeIdentityRepository resolves imported stable keys to live IDs while
// proving that the referenced lesson belongs to the referenced course.
type KnowledgeIdentityRepository interface {
	ResolveCourseLessonBindings(ctx Context, refs []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding) ([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, error)
}
